title: Score the picks — score_picks
text: score_picks() returns one row per player, team, day. add_changes() returns rows pick's points moved day . team's points missing first game, missing value counts 0: otherwise every team's first game drop changes. rows_for_day() keeps one day . projected_score_by_player() returns player's total points counts correct picks day (missing points count 0 correct). rank_players() returns players, best first, points, correct picks, correct 15-point picks, date closest today.
